simple.meaning: חַבּוּרָה (chabbûwrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, bound (with stripes), i.e. a weal (or black-and-blue mark itself).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַבּוּרָה (H2250) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 4:23, with occurrences in Genesis, Exodus, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַבּוּרָה (H2250) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חַבּוּרָה (H2250) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חַבּוּרָה (chabbûwrâh) / H2250 is traced through Genesis 4:23, Exodus 21:25, Psalms 38:6, Proverbs 20:30 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
